entries.dialogueText: The doors to the White Room, like everything else in the Maroon Palace's main nerve center, were painted white. I took a deep breath before pushing them open.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The attendees rose up from their se..."
entries.dialogueText: The attendees rose up from their seats.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Now that you are here, let's talk..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now that you are here, let's talk about our diplomatic strategy."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef nodded. He and Lucian sat dow..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef nodded. He and Lucian sat down, while Deivid remained standing.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We have successfully passed trade..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have successfully passed trade deals with both Wehlen and Agnolia, which means we have increased our presence in those regions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Time for yet another meeting. At le..."
entries.dialogueText: Time for yet another meeting. At least this time, it was with people who liked me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Mr. President, if I may, I would l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, if I may, I would like to provide you with a short overview of where we are at right now."

entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded and gestured for Deivid to..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded and gestured for Deivid to begin.
entries.menuText: Nod and gesture for Deivid to begin.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go ahead.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go ahead.”
entries.menuText: “Go ahead.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We decided not to pursue any deals..."
entries.dialogueText: “We decided not to pursue any deals with Wehlen and Agnolia, which means our presence in both regions is lacking.”

entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Although we did not make a trade d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although we did not make a trade deal with Agnolia, we succeeded in making one with Wehlen, which means we have increased our presence in the region.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Although we did not make a trade d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although we did not make a trade deal with Wehlen, we succeeded in making one with Agnolia, which means we have increased our presence in the region.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“These deals were important pieces..."
entries.dialogueText: “These deals were important pieces of leverage and significant first steps into the global arena.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We must now look towards the futur..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must now look towards the future.”

entries.menuText: “What do you mean by looking towards the future?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”
entries.menuText: “Go on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's time to take the next steps.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's time to take the next steps.”
entries.menuText: “It's time to take the next steps.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Precisely.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Precisely.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Wehlen and Agnolia were practice r..."
entries.dialogueText: “Wehlen and Agnolia were practice runs. We must begin improving our relationship with greater nations.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.dialogueText: “You know me. I don't trust the 'helping hands' other countries offer us. For a good reason.”

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“But I also know when those helping..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I also know when those helping hands are necessary. And right now, we need all the help we can get."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I've said this over and over, but..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've said this over and over, but I will repeat it until you get it through your skull: Rumburg will come. Sooner or later. ”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“And with the current state of our..."
entries.dialogueText: “And with the current state of our military, if a Rumburg invasion happens, Sordland will cease to exist.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We ought to head General Lancea's..."
entries.dialogueText: “We ought to head General Lancea's advice, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We need allies.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We need allies.”

entries.title: Player: "“Nonsense. Our country can defend i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nonsense. Our country can defend itself just fine without allies.”
entries.menuText: “Nonsense. Our country can defend itself just fine without allies.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your input. I will c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your input. I will consider it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I trust your assessment, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I trust your assessment, Iosef.”
entries.menuText: “I trust your assessment, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Let future generations of Sordish..."

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Thank you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.menuText: “Thank you for your input. I will consider it.”

entries.dialogueText: “But why not go a step further?”

entries.dialogueText: Deivid sat down, pulled out a few papers and started going through them as he kept talking.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We need to elevate our internation..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to elevate our international standing, especially with the threat of Rumburg looming."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
